bio.text: Chris Pappas represents New Hampshire's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House, serving on the Veterans' Affairs and Transportation and Infrastructure Committees, and is a 2026 candidate for U.S. Senate.
According to his campaign website, he ran his family's restaurant business in Manchester before Congress and served three terms on New Hampshire's Executive Council.
The site says he has held his congressional seat since 2018, attended public schools in Manchester, graduated from Harvard, and lives in Manchester.
